name: tradrl-adapters-arena
description: The Arena capability-provider adapter (W057) — the FIRST CONCRETE provider over the W056 provider-neutral interface (the W024 abides clean-room adapter precedent, the tradrl-adapters/* flat source-exported layout). Spec: REQUIREMENTS.md R055 — 'Arena is optional': the Arena is ONE optional provider, an equal member of the pluggable provider class, and this package is its venue-specific implementation — the arena vocabulary (venue kinds, round kinds, measurement regimes, leaderboard styles) is declared HERE and ONLY here, as closed sets with fail-closed validation. registerArenaProvider is the adapter's registration gate: the arena closed-set + structure laws first, then W056's registerProvider run VERBATIM over the projected provider-neutral declaration (R052 enforced at THAT gate — an unmeasured offer is refused there and carried here verbatim; never bypassed, never weakened). ArenaCapabilityProvider implements W056's CapabilityProviderPort deterministically in memory (listOffers in canonical offer-id order / describeOffer by exact id / the measured provenance accessor). adjudicateArenaOffers delegates to W056's matchProviderOffers VERBATIM (reasons carried), and projectArenaLeaderboard is the arena ranking projection — carried data ordered by CANONICAL IDS, never a re-scored statistic. validateArenaRegistration re-proves the whole registration from its recorded data, W056's validateProviderRegistration carried verbatim. A9 throughout; A14: the adapter COMPOSES typed data — it never executes an arena round, never calls a network, no marketplace or entitlements semantics (W058), no neutral-interface changes (frozen).
